about_short_description.short_description: Knowtex helps create visit notes from medical conversations.

product.name: Knowtex Clinical AI Platform
product.description: A healthcare AI platform that converts clinical conversations and fragmented healthcare data into structured documentation, automated workflows, coding outputs, and clinical insights.

product.name: Ambient Clinical AI Documentation
product.description: An ambient voice AI service that turns clinician-patient conversations into structured medical notes, reducing manual documentation and supporting direct review and EHR upload.

product.name: Automated Clinical Coding
product.description: An AI-assisted coding service that recommends diagnosis, CPT, and evaluation and management codes from clinical documentation to support accurate billing and code capture.

product.name: Clinical Workflow Automation
product.description: An AI automation service for executing repetitive documentation, coding, ordering, and care-coordination workflows across clinical departments.

product.name: Clinical Intelligence and EHR Insights
product.description: A clinical information and analytics service that summarizes patient records and operational activity into structured views for care delivery, review, and performance improvement.
